### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def numpy_pairwise_diff(vector: list) -> list:
    v = np.array(vector, dtype=np.float64)
    return np.round(v[:, np.newaxis] - v[np.newaxis, :], 6).tolist()
```
